scope: Offline code, real local Parquet fixtures, mocked AWS SDK responses and a historical 30,000-row sample pipeline. No AWS deployment or API execution.

reproduced_before_fixes.observed: Five assertions failed: changed Glue catalog semantics were accepted on upload resume.
Assertion failed: nonempty Parquet SerDe parameters passed read-only acceptance.

full_pytest.skip_reason: Optional local Iceberg dependency unavailable; existing separate CI job remains unchanged.

verification.unexpected_read_regression: Passed; closes Body once and asserts Body.read is never called.
verification.initial_environment_correction: Initial test collection could not locate the existing dbt executable. Adding the existing venv Scripts directory to PATH resolved it; no test expectation was weakened.

sample_pipeline.limit: Existing historical sample validation, not a full-data/cloud rerun or performance comparison; tests ran concurrently.

behavior_proved_offline: Plan binds exact source hash, account/region/roles, explicit budget declaration, UTC expiry, two queries and local oracle.
Altered/expired plans and failed acceptance/denial probes cannot start queries.
Publisher confirms fact object size/checksum before query-role one-byte probe. Missing-key responses are inconclusive; unexpected allowed reads fail without consuming the body.
Idempotency tokens are persisted before submission and stable on restart. Prior known IDs/measurements survive a failed restart.
Failed/cancelled queries retain known scan counters; timeout retains provisional counters and requests cancellation without claiming terminal state.
Result mismatch or malformed responses stop further submission. Network failure after submission retains query ID and avoids persisting SDK error text.
Resumed catalog registration and read-only acceptance reject changed parsing semantics.

synthetic_oracle.limit: Hand-calculated fixture and mocked service counters, not AWS measurements.

not_demonstrated: Authenticated account/region and approved numeric spending cap
Effective AWS permissions or actual denied requests
Real Athena execution and result reconciliation
Cloud restoration, measured charges or sustained operation
